messages.subject: Global Mining & Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Oxwana Team,

Your executive-search focus across mining and resources, energy and renewables, industrials and infrastructure aligns closely with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where mining or energy strategy depends on regulatory discipline, institutional trust and responsible development. I am internationally mobile, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
